title: CBCA public-information platform is being established
summary: The Alliance is preparing verified member records, public guidance, scholarship-policy transparency and student-protection systems.

title: University scholarship-policy database under preparation
summary: CBCA will publish documented scholarship coverage, renewal conditions, hidden costs, refund rules and student-impact warnings using verified sources.

title: Misinformation correction and complaint procedures being introduced
summary: Consultancies may be formally notified when inaccurate public claims are documented. Students will be able to submit evidence-based complaints by email.
